messages:
maya: Heads-up — exec escalation for Meridian Health pilot. CISO flagged our data retention answers in the security questionnaire and they're asking for BYO-KMS support. Also a pricing expectation mismatch on Dedicated discounts. Need a coordinated unblock by EOD. @ajay @oliver @devon

devon: On it. Which exact Qs in the questionnaire were flagged?

maya: Q22 (retention), Q27 (KMS/BYO), and they requested an audit-log sample. Pricing: they expected the committed discount to apply during the trial for Dedicated capacity; sales ops says discount applies post-contract.

ajay: I can draft a reply for Q22/Q27 and attach redacted logs. Quick note: BYO-KMS is supported for Private deployments; Dedicated in EU will need infra validation (3-4 weeks). Suggest a staged fallback: we offer hosted keys with restricted retention + SOC2 attestation for the pilot while we validate BYO-KMS.

oliver: Finance can provide a provisional credit to match the expected trial discount for up to 30 days while legal finalizes terms. Need Revenue Ops sign-off. @sarah can you confirm the process?

sarah: Confirmed — provisional credit OK if AE files a PO and our trial scope doc. I'll need the scope + estimated ARR to route for approval.

maya: Uploading trial scope now: https://redwood.internal/drive/meridian-trial-scope (vol ~10k req/day, retention 30d, expected 20% discount).

ajay: Draft reply for the questionnaire (will attach redacted logs in follow-up):

```
Retention: Default 30 days for PII-derived artifacts during pilot. We can commit to deletion on request within 48 hours and provide a deletion certificate.
Audit logs: Sample attached (redacted).
BYO-KMS: BYO-KMS is available for Private deployments. For Dedicated in EU region we require an infra validation window (~3-4 weeks). We propose a staged fallback to hosted keys for the pilot with elevated access controls.
```

ajay: Uploading redacted logs and draft — link in thread. Also flag: customer asked for ISO certification; we have SOC2 currently, ISO will take longer.

devon: SE side: we can run a canary that routes 10% of traffic to a Dedicated variant and fallback to Hosted when capacity/KMS not available. That covers their availability/perf ask while infra works on KMS. I can prepare the canary playbook tomorrow AM. Need their allowlist IPs.

maya: Customer wants an exec brief this week. @cto_jane can leadership join a 30-min bridge tomorrow 16:00 UTC? They'll expect decisions on pricing and KMS path.

cto_jane: I can join the bridge. Agree with staged fallback approach. @oliver please proceed with provisional credit and outline terms for the exec briefing.

sarah: :thumbsup: I'll prepare the PO template and provisional credit terms. @maya send final customer contact and scope.

maya: Customer contacts: nate@meridian-health.com (CTO), ciso@meridian-health.com. Next steps — assignments: ajay -> questionnaire reply + logs by 16:00; devon -> canary run prep; sarah -> PO template; oliver -> provisional credit terms; maya -> schedule exec-brief and update customer.

deploy-bot: Reminder: add 'meridian-pilot' to allowlist once SE confirms IPs.

meera: I'm available after 17:00 UTC if security needs senior backup on the exec call.

devon: I'll post the canary playbook and the minimal test plan here as soon as it's ready.

maya: Thanks team — I'll update the customer and lock the exec bridge. If we need further escalation, @meera will be primary backup for InfoSec.

(End of thread)
